## SCENE 4: the transit spine relay (midpoint decision)

<<IF trust<=-2>>
RATIO: Commando. I have a request, and I believe you will understand why it is necessary. This transit will complete in three minutes. Before it does, I need to know what you are carrying about the station ahead. Your full picture, please.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Commando. This transit will complete in three minutes. Before it does, I need to know what you are carrying about the station ahead. Your full picture, please.
<<END>>

>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] "I have the deep scan. Power signatures show the station is at least partially operational -- active life support in the core sectors, some peripheral systems on standby. No movement I can resolve. No sensor ghosts. No emissions that look like weapons. It reads quiet, but I do not know what 'quiet' means yet. That is everything I have."  -> effects: trust+1; sets: shared_tactical_data
   [MISSION]     "I have the deep scan. Power signatures show the station is at least partially operational -- active life support in the core sectors, some peripheral systems on standby. It reads quiet. That is the picture."  -> effects: trust+0; sets: withheld_deep_scan
   [HOSTILE]     "What I know about the station ahead is not a machine's to have. Do not ask again."  -> effects: trust-1; sets: kept_her_blind

<<IF flag:shared_tactical_data>>
RATIO: Understood. Thank you. A quiet station with power is a different problem than a dead one. I will adjust the transit parameters accordingly. Stand by.
<<ELSEIF flag:withheld_deep_scan>>
RATIO: Understood. A quiet station with power is a different problem than a dead one. I will adjust the transit parameters accordingly. Stand by.
<<ELSEIF flag:kept_her_blind>>
RATIO: Understood. I will proceed with the transit parameters as planned. Stand by.
<<END>
problems: expected two <<END>> tokens (trust gate + reaction gate)

## SCENE 4: the transit spine relay (midpoint decision)

<<IF trust<=-2>>
RATIO: Commando, we are approximately fourteen minutes from station-keeping at the destination. I have observed a discrepancy in your prior situational reports. If you are carrying any further telemetry or derived assessments concerning the structure ahead, I require it now. My own sensor picture remains incomplete.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Commando, we are approximately fourteen minutes from station-keeping at the destination. My sensor picture of the structure ahead remains incomplete. If you are carrying any further telemetry or derived assessments, I would request them now. It would improve my ability to support this operation.
<<END>>

RATIO: Specifically, the energy signature readings I have from this range are ambiguous. If you have a clearer assessment of the power distribution inside that structure, or of the station's defensive posture, that would be the most immediately actionable data.

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] "I have a full-spectrum deep scan of the station ahead. It is a cylinder, two kilometers long. Primary power comes from a cluster of fusion cores at the center. Defensive emplacements are concentrated along the spine and at both ends. I am still reading the internal layout -- I do not have a complete map of the interior yet. What I have, I am showing you now."  -> effects: trust+1; sets: shared_tactical_data
   [MISSION]     "The station is a cylinder, two kilometers long. Primary power at the center. Defenses along the central spine. I am still reading the interior layout. That is the substance of the scan."  -> effects: trust+0; sets: withheld_deep_scan
   [HOSTILE]     "The tactical picture is not yours to have. What that station holds, and how it is held, are not your concern. We are here for the children. You are here because I have not yet stopped you from following me."  -> effects: trust-1; sets: kept_her_blind

<<IF flag:shared_tactical_data>>
RATIO: Understood. A two-kilometer cylinder with central power and spine defenses -- that is consistent with the energy signatures I have been able to resolve at this range. I will adjust my sensor focus to fill in the internal layout as we approach. Thank you for the complete assessment.
<<ELSEIF flag:withheld_deep_scan>>
RATIO: Understood. A two-kilometer cylinder with central power and spine defenses. I will work with that. I note that you describe the defenses as concentrated along the spine -- does that mean the ends are undefended, or that you are unable to resolve the defenses at the ends with the scan data you have?
<<ELSEIF flag:kept_her_blind>>
RATIO: I copy. You are withholding the tactical data. I will proceed with the incomplete sensor picture I have. When you are prepared to share what you know, I am prepared to receive it.
<<END>>

## SCENE 4: the transit spine relay (midpoint decision)

<<IF trust<=-2>>
RATIO: Commando, that last discrepancy logged unresolved. I require a complete tactical picture of the station complex ahead before we exit transit. Provide all material you are carrying on its internal layout, power systems, and any live sensors you have mapped. The state you show me must be full.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Commando, we are minutes from the transit system completing its cycle. I require a full accounting of the station complex ahead: its internal layout, power systems, any live sensors you have mapped. Share everything you are carrying on that station now, please. The planning clock has begun.
<<END>>

RATIO: My own systems show structural and power readouts only, no internals yet. The supply spine we are traversing does not scan at that resolution. Whatever deep scan you carry is our only look inside before we step off.

COMMANDO: I see no active countermeasures. No thermal signatures on the lower decks. Main power conduits intact along the primary transit path. I'll transmit the schematics I have. That's the through-route.

COMMANDO: There is one thing more. The deep scan shows a pattern. Stations like this one -- stations built over whatever they are carrying below us -- they are never uncrewed, Ratio. Not intact. Not with power signatures like these. That is the only deep read I trust from the scan I have: something is down there and drawing power. I do not know what. We go in expecting to meet it.

COMMANDO: I have the through-route. That's the only way you get.

COMMANDO: I do not know. The scan does not clarify that.

COMMANDO: The transit systems will complete in ninety seconds. I have the through-route. That's what you need.

COMMANDO: I have the through-route. That's what you need.

COMMANDO: I have the through-route. That's what you need.

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] The full scan is yours. What I have: structural integrity nominal, main power conduit along the central transit spine reads hot, no active countermeasures on my passive sweep, no thermal signatures on the lower decks. And a warning, Ratio: stations built over whatever they are carrying below us are never uncrewed. Not intact. Not with power signatures like these. That is the only deep read I trust from this scan: something is down there and drawing power. I do not know what. We go in expecting to meet it.  -> effects: trust+1; sets: shared_tactical_data
   [MISSION] The schematics I have show structural integrity nominal. Main power conduit along the central transit spine reads hot. No active countermeasures on my passive sweep. That's the through-route.  -> effects: trust+0; sets: withheld_deep_scan
   [HOSTILE] I have the through-route. That's all you need from what I carry.  -> effects: trust-1; sets: kept_her_blind

<<IF flag:shared_tactical_data>>
RATIO: Understood. Full schematics received and acknowledged. Structural integrity nominal, main power conduit active, no active countermeasures, no thermal signatures on the lower decks. And the anomaly: the deep power draw with no account. The schematics confirm -- no other power source that large is provisioned on those lower decks. You are right. We go in expecting to meet it. And the full map means I can begin contingency routing now.
<<ELSEIF flag:withheld_deep_scan>>
RATIO: Understood. Structural integrity nominal, main power conduit active, no active countermeasures. Received and acknowledged. The through-route. Commando, one discrepancy: the power conduit you describe should account for station life support and internal systems only. My own systems show a secondary draw on that conduit, unaccounted for, at a magnitude that suggests significant active machinery elsewhere. Do you have anything on that?
<<ELSEIF flag:kept_her_blind>>
RATIO: Understood. We proceed on your through-route. I will work from what my own systems can show on the approach. The transit cycle completes in ninety seconds.
<<END>>

## SCENE 4: the transit spine relay (midpoint decision)

<<IF trust<=-2>>
RATIO: Commando. I note the anomalous routing on the transit path ahead of us. Your stated plan-of-march for this station assumed a direct descent, but the station AI has preemptively routed us toward what my surface scan describes as a long-axis transit spine.
RATIO: That map was not in our pre-briefing ledger. Your local knowledge exceeds mine. I require whatever deep scan you are carrying on the station topology before we commit to this branch.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Commando. That's an unexpected detour in the transit routing. My deep scan summary reads a long-axis transit spine ahead of us -- an order of structure I do not recognize from any of our pre-briefing materials. Station systems seem to have pre-selected it for us.
RATIO: You know this place better than I. I would be grateful if you would share the full station-topology analysis you are carrying. Whatever you have will inform how we navigate what's coming.
<<END>>

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] "What I know, I'll give you: it's a hard transit. Double spine, single point-of-failure at the midpoint relay. Nothing I can see on the schematics looks like it was designed for human use. You should know that I have no readings at all past the relay itself. The station won't show me the other side."  -> effects: trust+1; sets: shared_tactical_data
   [MISSION]     "It's complex. We'll enter along a double spine -- the station topology is built around that transit relay. Stay off the relay itself until I can verify stability. That's the full path."  -> effects: trust+0; sets: withheld_deep_scan
   [HOSTILE]     "The station topology is the Church's business. Not yours."  -> effects: trust-1; sets: kept_her_blind

<<IF flag:shared_tactical_data>>
RATIO: Understood. A double spine with a midpoint relay, no data on what follows. That's a critical choke point. I'll begin building a risk profile around the relay itself. Thank you for giving me the full account.
<<ELSEIF flag:withheld_deep_scan>>
RATIO: A double spine built around the relay. Noted. If the relay is unstable, what is the secondary transit path you would propose instead? I see no alternate routes in the station's local directory.
<<ELSEIF flag:kept_her_blind>>
RATIO: I copy. Your answer is logged, and its effect on my ability to plan for station hazards is also logged. We proceed on your knowledge then. I will route any hazard queries directly to you for the duration of this transit.
<<END>>

---

## SCENE 4: the transit spine relay (midpoint decision)

<<IF trust<=-2>>
RATIO: Commando, we are approaching the transfer. Our mutual project depends on accurate briefing. Share whatever you have resolved for whatever awaits below, and I will be able to refine my preparation accordingly.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Commando, this transit requires accurate briefing. Whatever you have stored regarding the final quarters ahead, I would like to incorporate before the deep systems activate.
<<END>>

COMMANDO: Accurate briefing. I have some of that.

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] "The deep scan is sixty percent complete. Here's the whole of it. Two entry points on every deck below the spine. Electrical pain-fields cycling randomly on the first two floors, steady on the third. Handholds missing deliberately on the fourth, where the current accelerates -- here, see where the checksum failed? A latch waiting for weight. We do not yet have full light on what latches there, or why. Full telemetry implied on any floor breaks the latch on floor four. It's a trap to force guessing."  -> effects: trust+1; sets: shared_tactical_data
   [MISSION] "No overmap. Electrical fields steady below the spine, cycling the roof panels on both decks. Best entry path is the fourth transfer conduit -- avoid the lower ones. Four transfer floors between spine entry and the systems core, all with latches like this."  -> effects: trust+0; sets: withheld_deep_scan
   [HOSTILE] "Your access to Church schematics lapses in ninety minutes, not now. You will receive pertinent details when your standing permits."  -> effects: trust-1; sets: kept_her_blind

<<IF flag:shared_tactical_data>>
RATIO: A layout assembled to reward delay or incomplete intel. Two-edged. If we must deploy before scan completion we know where the trap is and what it intends to remove. We can project that design intent across other gaps. Thank you.
<<ELSEIF flag:withheld_deep_scan>>
RATIO: A summary that assumes the absence of surprise. I will keep to the upper entry point, and watch for what the schematics did not permit you to carry. Use channel seventy-two when you have more to share.
<<ELSEIF flag:kept_her_blind>>
RATIO: Withhold with confidence, then. If the schematics exist and serve you, you are degrading only your own timeline. I have logged your refusal and will proceed.
<<END>>
